pageToken.description: The *pageToken* parameter identifies a specific page in the result set that should be returned. In an API response, the nextPageToken property identify other pages that could be retrieved.

part.description: The *part* parameter specifies the liveChatComment resource parts that the API response will include. Supported values are id, snippet, and authorDetails.

stream.description: Allows a user to load live chat through a server-streamed RPC.
